note: These are working intent hypotheses derived from observed AmazonHelp TWCS traffic. They must be human-reviewed before becoming golden-set ground truth.

intents.description: Delivery status, tracking, delayed shipment, missing parcel, or delivered-but-not-received issue.
Order-specific problem such as wrong item, incorrect destination, order change, cancellation, or order details.
Return, refund, replacement, or reimbursement request for an order or purchase.
Payment, charge, billing, Amazon Payments, or unexpected transaction issue.
Account access, sign-in, password, account closure, verification, or account-related issue.
Prime membership, Prime trial, renewal, cancellation, or Prime membership charge.
Prime Video, Kindle, digital purchase, streaming, playback, or digital-content issue.
Echo, Kindle, Fire TV, or other Amazon device malfunction or troubleshooting issue.
Amazon app, website, checkout interface, or software functionality problem.
Question about a product, availability, price, preorder, delivery estimate, or product-page information.
Support request that does not fit a more specific intent or requires additional context.
General feedback or complaint without a clearly actionable support intent.
Insufficient information, unsupported request, or genuinely ambiguous intent.
